description:
Superb Two Bedroom Two Bath First Floor Apartment | Approx. 70+ sq. m. | Walk-In Wardrobe | Ensuite | Turn-Key Condition

Leonard Wilson Keenan are delighted to present to the market this superb two bedroom, two bathroom first floor apartment, ideally positioned within the highly sought-after Hampton Wood development in Finglas, Dublin 11.

Extending to an impressive over 70 sq. m., this spacious apartment offers exceptionally well-proportioned accommodation throughout, with the added benefit of a walk-in wardrobe, ensuite bathroom and numerous storage areas, making this an ideal home for modern-day living.

Upon entering, you are immediately greeted by a welcoming hallway, with a beautifully presented family bathroom conveniently positioned to the right. The first bedroom is an excellent double room and remains particularly spacious despite the inclusion of a fantastic walk-in wardrobe, while also benefiting from its own ensuite bathroom. This is an excellent feature and provides both privacy and convenience.

The second bedroom is slightly larger again and is a bright and generously proportioned room. It benefits from excellent natural light and pleasant views over the beautifully maintained communal areas to the rear of the development.

The living accommodation is a particular highlight. The spacious living room is presented in turn-key condition and is flooded with natural light, while its first-floor position provides an excellent level of privacy. The adjoining kitchen is ideally suited to modern open-plan living and provides ample workspace, storage and all the necessary appliances, creating a practical and sociable area for day-to-day living and entertaining.

The property further benefits from excellent storage throughout, which is a particularly attractive feature for those seeking generous accommodation without compromising on practicality.

The property further boasts double-glazed windows and a gas-fired central heating system with an energy-efficient boiler.

There is a designated parking space in addition to visitor parking.

Hampton Wood is a most sought-after residential development, ideally positioned adjacent to a host of local amenities. Finglas Village is within easy reach, and the area benefits from an excellent choice of both primary and secondary schools, together with numerous parks and recreational facilities.

There is also a large Centra store within the development itself, providing excellent convenience for everyday shopping. The Charlestown Shopping Centre, incorporating the Odeon Cinema, is quite literally on your doorstep, while IKEA is also within immediate proximity.

The location is particularly well positioned for commuters and families alike. DCU is within close proximity, while an excellent bus service provides access to the City Centre via a Quality Bus Corridor. The M50 motorway is also within easy reach, providing convenient access to the wider Dublin area and beyond.

This is a wonderful opportunity to acquire a bright, spacious and beautifully presented two-bedroom apartment in a mature and highly regarded development. With its generous floor area, excellent bedroom accommodation, walk-in wardrobe, ensuite, superb living space and enviable location, this property is sure to appeal to first-time buyers, owner-occupiers and investors alike.

Early viewing is strongly advised to appreciate all that this wonderful home has to offer.
